headline: New Method in Tax Audits! Şimşek: Increasing Compliance Before Penalties Are Imposed
summary: Turkey's Tax Inspection Board will introduce a new practice in tax examinations. Finance Minister Şimşek said the aim is to raise voluntary taxpayer compliance before penalties are imposed.
why: Changes to tax audit practice affect corporate compliance costs and the predictability of tax enforcement for businesses operating in Turkey.
